Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental error in applying domain knowledge regarding diurnal temperature variation. It incorrectly estimated that on a "sunny" day, the afternoon temperature would only rise by ~10°F (predicting ~51°F), leading it to select 41°F as the closest option. This contradicts basic meteorological principles where sunny days typically see a significant temperature increase (often 20-30°F or more) from morning to mid-afternoon. Consequently, the Planner failed to identify 78°F as the most logical answer for a sunny day and prematurely concluded the task without verifying its assumptions against general knowledge or available tools.
